name: ChronoMagic-Bench
description: ChronoMagic-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating temporal and metamorphic knowledge skills in text-to-time-lapse video generation. It includes 1,649 prompts and real-world reference videos across four major time-lapse categories, with new automatic metrics MTScore and CHScore to assess metamorphic amplitude and temporal coherence.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that has started to define evaluation for text-to-time-lapse video generation, but it is still early in community adoption.
notes: Also introduces ChronoMagic-Pro dataset with 460k video-caption pairs; focuses on physics, biology, and chemistry capabilities in video generation.
